notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Horseshoe Crab and Mona Lisa are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Mona Lisa.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
